title: Transport isomorphism for an isomorphic source
statement:
theorem exists_isomorphic_single_tensor_counit_transport
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive]
    {X P Z : Scheme.{u}} (p : P ⟶ X) (e : Z ≅ P) :
    let a := Classical.choose (exists_schemeDerivedAdjunction e.hom
      (hAdd := (Classical.choose exists_derivedPullbackComposition) e.hom)
      ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)) e.hom)
      ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))) e.hom))
    let b := (conjugateIsoEquiv
      (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (e.hom ≫ p)))
      ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction p)).comp
        (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction e.hom)))).symm
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp e.hom p).symm
    ∃ t : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (e.hom ≫ p) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) 0) ⋙
      schemeDerivedDirectImage e.hom ≅
      Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p ⋙ DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings P.toRingedSpace)) 0,
      ∀ M : X.Modules,
        t.inv.app M =
          a.unit.app ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings P.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p).obj M)) ≫
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage e.hom).map
            (pinnedSingleTensorCounit e.hom 0 ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p).obj M) ≫
              (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) 0).map (b.hom.app M))

source.place: Derived pullback composition and adjunction transport

proof.text: Tensor pullback along e is an equivalence: compose pullback along e.hom and e.inv using nonempty_tensorPullbackComp, the scheme inverse identities, and nonempty_tensorPullbackId. Its exactness gives mapDerivedCategory and its factorization through Qh. Thus termwise pullback followed by Qh inverts quasi-isomorphisms. Mathlib Functor.isIso_of_isLeftDerivedFunctor_of_inverts makes the composition-pinned counit invertible.

Compare the recorded derived pullback to the exact functor mapDerivedCategory using Functor.leftDerivedUnique with the specified pinned counit. The upstream instance Functor.isEquivalence_mapDerivedCategory and Functor.isEquivalence_of_iso make the recorded derived pullback an equivalence. The specified adjunction then makes derived direct image an equivalence, hence its unit invertible.

Whisker the pinned counit by the degree-zero homotopy single functor and compose with Qh applied to SingleFunctors.mappedHomotopySingleIso. Its component formula is pinnedSingleTensorCounit by mappedHomotopySingleIso_hom_app; both factors are invertible. Whisker the adjunction unit by p-pullback followed by single, then compose with direct image of this comparison and of the single image of the canonical underived comparison b.hom. This explicitly constructs an invertible natural transformation tau in the inverse direction. Take (asIso tau).symm, expand components and functor.map_comp, and use the counit component formula to obtain exactly the asserted inverse components.
